notes: Enter reps and weight now opens as a full-screen page. Each weightable exercise offers a Body weight / With weight choice (weight box appears only for With weight); calories update live for the mode you pick. Fulka and chapati split: thin fulka (75 kcal, 2.5 g protein) vs bigger chapati/roti (120 kcal, 3.8 g); mess fulka uses the thin fulka, with a +Nandini ghee option. Nutrition set from IFCT 2017 (NIN/ICMR): fulka 3.3 g protein/piece (varies by flour), cooked rice 3.6 g/katori, cucumber salad 1.2 g/bowl. Nutrition corrected: chapati/fulka (~100 kcal, 3 g protein), cooked rice per katori (~170 kcal, 3.5 g protein), cucumber salad (30 kcal, 1.2 g protein). Mess fulka now offers plain or +Nandini ghee (5 g ghee). Dishes written A / B on the mess menu now alternate week by week (only the week's option shows) in both D and E. Ate more now shows a Today's <mess>-mess meal button for whichever mess you pick (A shows a not-added-yet note); dishes written A / B alternate week by week. A meal collapsed with That's-it now stays collapsed when you reopen Ate more (remembered per day, mess and profile; reset on day-clear or when you expand it). Mess labels in reminders and Add-what-you-ate now show the mess you picked (D-mess or E-mess) instead of always saying E. D mess menu added and E mess updated to the 22/09 rota; the app now shows the menu, reminders and Add-what-you-ate meals for whichever mess (D or E) you pick in the You tab. A mess still to come. Each meal in the E-mess picker now has a That's-it toggle that collapses that meal's menu once you're done with it (tap again to reopen), so you are not scrolling every meal at once. The reps/weight page now has - / + steppers and shows each exercise's calories burned live (as a negative), updating as you change reps or weight - computed from the same work-against-gravity model the app logs. The live macro readout now spells out Protein, Carbs, Fat and Fibre, one per row. Each E-mess meal item now shows a live macro readout (kcal, protein, carbs, fat, fibre) that updates as you tap - / + or type the amount. The per-meal "already logged" record now persists across reloads (saved per day and per profile, cleared on a day-clear), so no food ever shows a cross-meal false positive. Fixed: a food shared across meals (milk in breakfast and snacks) no longer shows as already logged in the other meal - the picker and reminders now track what you entered per meal, not by the day total. In the IISc Veg Mess popup, tapping a mess now highlights it with a teal outline and a Save button confirms the choice. IISc Veg Mess: the You tab now asks "Do you eat at the IISc Veg Mess?" with an A/D/E mess selector, and a one-time popup asks on update. Menus and reminders are active for E mess (A/D coming). Fixed the Fulka item logging as Chapati. Dishes you've already logged for a meal are now tucked into a collapsed "Already logged" group in the E-mess picker (and dropped from meal reminders), so you only see what's still pending. E-mess amount boxes now have - / + steppers (0.5 for fulka/katori/piece, 50 ml for liquids, 10 g for dry weights); you can still type any value. E-mess meal windows set to the real times (breakfast 7:30-10:00, lunch 12:30-14:00, snacks 16:30-18:00, dinner 19:30-21:00): reminders now nudge from each window's start and the meal picker offers a meal once its window has begun. E-mess meal entry is now one page: tick a dish and an amount box opens under it (fulka/katori in 0.5 steps, liquids in 50 ml, or type your own), with one time per meal at its heading. Fixed: mess-meal amounts now count toward the day's calories and show in What you ate. E-mess (IISc): Add-what-you-ate now has a Today's E-mess meal button that lists every meal whose time has already passed, lets you tick dishes across them, then set amount and time for each on one page. Plus the earlier Exercised enlarge/flip body map and the day's E-mess menu in meal reminders. Exercised flow: a search bar plus the front/back body map, with a new Enlarge view that shows one side at a time and a Flip button for precise muscle picking; the muscles you pick are named as you go. New E-mess (IISc) menu: a profile toggle that surfaces the day's E-mess breakfast/lunch/snacks/dinner in your meal reminders (each meal on its own, with an Exercised prompt), driven by the weekly rota; the whole menu stays searchable. Footer now links to the author's site and a contact email.
